messages.text:
Hello Helium D. Support,

I am writing to request official clarification regarding my upcoming order for two 40T miners, which are scheduled to ship in a few days.

Before placing my order, your promotional videos and chat representatives heavily advertised the 50 TH/s hash rate as a standard operating option for these units. However, I recently discovered through community Discord discussions that, if true, running the miners at this advertised 50 TH/s rate completely voids the manufacturer warranty.

It is highly concerning to see a specific performance tier used as a primary selling point, only to find out post-purchase that utilizing it strips the buyer of their warranty protection.

Could you please confirm your official warranty policy regarding the 50 TH/s operating mode? I need to understand exactly what is covered, and why this critical warranty limitation was not clearly disclosed prior to purchase.

I am holding off on making any decisions regarding my order until I hear back, but I need this clarified before my units ship.

Thank you,

Larry D.
The Node Runner LLC
